content.short: NFT horse collection on Cardano, offering a rich gaming experience with six horse dynasties, diverse race types, and earning opportunities.
content.description:
Diamond Hooves is a dynamic NFT horse collection on Cardano, offering a rich gaming experience with six horse dynasties, diverse race types, and earning opportunities through its unique deflationary token system.

Diamond Hooves is a collection of 6000 NFT horses, transforming digital horse ownership on Cardano. Featuring six dynasties, our world offers thrilling two-legged races & three game types: Minigames, Games, & Races. Players earn our deflationary token, enabling upgrades for in-game & race advantages.
